name: Fathom
description: Fathom is an AI-powered meeting assistant that records, transcribes, summarizes, and highlights video calls.

evidence.claim: Generate an API key and make your first call in minutes. Use our Typescript or Python SDK. Set up a webhook for your meetings.
Partners can register an OAuth app to be eligible for a future marketplace listing as a Fathom-approved integration.
Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.

notes: Fathom provides both a user-level API key method and an OAuth app registration for partners, alongside an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
